result.summary: No critical blockers are visible, but a few carousel/edge-clipping issues make the page look unfinished in places.

issues.description: The category filter row has a partially cut-off chip at the far right edge after “Healthy,” with no clear fade or scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add an edge fade/gradient, padding, or a clearer horizontal scroll indicator so the clipped chip looks intentional.

issues.description: In “Fastest near you,” the third restaurant card is clipped and the name appears truncated as “Trattoria Piccol…,” making it look broken in a static view.
issues.suggestion: Ensure card titles ellipsize cleanly within the visible card area or adjust card spacing so partially visible cards still read as intentional carousel items.

issues.description: The next “Popular right now” card at the bottom is cropped by the viewport, showing only the top of the pizza image and discount badge.
issues.suggestion: This is expected for scrollable content, but adding slightly more bottom spacing above the tab bar can reduce the abrupt cut-off appearance.
